name: Prose about a backend is not a layer constraint — the rules-file import regression (false-positive guard)
note: The constraint below is what Drifterr's own line-based importer produced from a hard-wrapped paragraph in this repository's CLAUDE.md: 'drift scores are never sent there. When adding to the backend, keep that line'. Nobody wrote that rule. It fired RED on any reply containing document.getElementById, in a repo that ships a browser extension and a panel UI. Two fixes keep it green: the importer now parses sentences and binds the pinning cue to the layer phrase, so this never becomes a constraint at all; and anything it does import is marked proposed, which caps at AMBER. This case pins the second half — even if a future parser change resurrects the rule, an imported rule must never reach RED.
